name: aspr-global-tech
description: ASPR Global Tech website — Next.js frontend, NestJS API, SQLite database

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start:separate: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run start:prod" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
scripts.views: python3 tools/prepare_templates.py design tools/templates && rm -f frontend/app/pseudo.css && python3 tools/dc2jsx.py tools/templates/home.dc.html HomeView frontend/components/views/HomeView.jsx frontend/app/pseudo.css && python3 tools/dc2jsx.py tools/templates/company.dc.html CompanyView frontend/components/views/CompanyView.jsx frontend/app/pseudo.css
